lines: In place of a lost halo, a fluorescent lamp, a fluorescent lamp.
In an age full of fakes, they appear to shine.
Is it better to hide it? Better yet, to break it? Better to do it?
Can I be my true self?
An unending night, again my breathing is disturbed.
A desire just hatched.
The rain of sorrow steals away my heat.
A life merely sucking the nectar from a flower blooming in full glory
Was somehow mistaken.
We, with our feathers plucked,
Challenge the question, “Who am I?”
Even if we are mere facades, we should just say we are not alone.
The heart that avoids the future, and the heart that desires it, we should just cut and connect them.
When we try, try, try to leap out, even if we crawl on the ground, do not abandon us.
If the sunlight that shines upon us is warm,
We do not need to hear the words that reject you, or the voices that fear you.
We do not need to know the misfortune that divides pain, or the happiness that shares it.
To the question we try, try, try to escape, even if we are confused, we will arrive.
The signal is the sound of a whistle. Do not hide; sing of what is right.
Near closing time, we rush to the merry-go-round, merry-go-round.
With a machine going in circles, our unease will not disappear.
Is it better to entrust it? Better yet, to abandon it? What do I care?
Will even my ambiguous self be rewarded?
A night when no one is around, so my breathing stands out.
I always spin it, so I do not forget that I am myself.
Because even a flower blooming in full glory will someday wither,
I realize I was living each and every moment.
We, with our feathers plucked,
Defy blind conformity.
Even if we are mere facades, we should just say we are not alone.
The heart that avoids the future, and the heart that desires it, we should just cut and connect them.
When we try, try, try to leap out, even if we crawl on the ground, do not abandon us.
Because the sunlight that shines upon us is warm,
We do not need to hear the words that reject you, or the voices that fear you.
We do not need to know the misfortune that divides pain, or the happiness that shares it.
To the question we try, try, try to escape, even if we are confused, we will choose our way through.
I will not let both my eyes cloud over. I accept both differences and inferiority.
The signal is the sound of a whistle. Do not hide; sing of what is right.
Wandering, mixing, becoming a pattern, we are agate.
Mistaken, piercing through, we are shining agate, whoa-oh.
Wandering, mixing, even the remnants of days we cannot return to now
Must be shining as proof that we are not fakes.
